text: For high-stakes contexts the authors note that online training is lost, so distribution shifts, alignment faking and coordinated errors not captured by the reward signal must be handled another way. They also ask how much honesty plus absence of alignment faking translates into aligned actions during alignment research, and how deployment environments can be designed to minimise risk while keeping the system useful.
title: Open: extending to high stakes, and how much honesty buys alignment
